PotentialThreat.description:
A potential threat from the potential threat catalog.

A potential threat is a threat scenario assessed against every service.

createTime.description: UTC timestamp when the threat was added to the catalog.

category.description: The security domain this potential threat belongs to.

replaces.description: Ids of predecessor potential threats this entry replaces; content previously derived from a predecessor may be re-issued under this threat.

PotentialThreat.title: PotentialThreat

PotentialThreatCategory.description:
The security domain a potential threat belongs to, used to group related threats. Each threat has exactly one category; OTHER indicates no listed domain fits.

Values:
- ENCRYPTION: Exposure of data through missing or weakened encryption or key controls.
- PERMISSIONS_AND_IDENTITY: Unauthorized access through missing or weakened authentication, authorization, or data-perimeter controls.
- NETWORK: Attacks through network reachability, placement, or traffic paths.
- LOGGING: Loss or evasion of activity and data-access logs.
- MONITORING_AND_METRICS: Undetected activity through missing metrics or telemetry.
- AVAILABILITY: Service disruption, capacity exhaustion, or loss of availability.
- DATA_RETENTION_AND_RESILIENCE: Loss of data or resources through deletion or insufficient retention.
- TAGGING: Governance gaps through missing or manipulated resource tags.
- CODE_INTEGRITY: Execution of untrusted, unreviewed, or unsigned code or content on a resource.
- OTHER: Does not fit a listed security domain.
